summary: RetroDash is a pixel-art rhythm game where you play a song's melody on the FM-1 keys while the rest is played for you from emulated SNES audio. The two-song beta is not yet tested on hardware.
features: Two built-in songs from Chrono Trigger and Final Fantasy VI
Each pitch keeps the same key; key lights show next notes
SNES SPC sound played by an S-DSP emulator on the device
Adjustable scroll speed, playback speed, offset and backing level
AUTO mode, pause menu and combo feedback
No song import over USB; songs are built into the firmware
